vulnerability_type: Inconsistent Taxed Fees and Transferable Amount

preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some MANU tokens to initiate transfer
Contract must have at least 3 token holders (including attacker) for the reward distribution to trigger

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the tax calculation and distribution logic. When a transfer occurs, the contract calculates a tax (tLiquidity) and distributes it to existing token holders. However, the same tax amount is also subtracted from total supply and added to marketing_address, creating an inconsistency. To exploit: 1. Ensure there are at least 3 token holders (create multiple addresses if needed). 2. Transfer tokens between two attacker-controlled addresses. 3. The tax distribution will credit the attacker's third address with rewards while also burning tokens from total supply, causing the attacker's relative ownership to increase. Repeat transfers to accumulate more tokens.
